#!/bin/bash
# One arm of the Q2 matrix: force a launch failure or a mid-turn abandonment
# through the SUBPROCESS form of the Claude Code primitive, and record every
# observable a caller could read.
LAB="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
ARM="$1"; shift
OUT="$LAB/log/$ARM"; rm -rf "$OUT"; mkdir -p "$OUT"
export CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR_UNUSED=1
TDIR="$HOME/.claude/projects"
# transcript census BEFORE, so a new transcript is attributable to this arm
find "$TDIR" -name '*.jsonl' -newermt '-1 second' 2>/dev/null | wc -l > /dev/null
find "$TDIR" -name '*.jsonl' 2>/dev/null | sort > "$OUT/transcripts.before"
START=$(date +%s)
mkdir -p "$LAB/work/$ARM"
cd "$LAB/work/$ARM"
set +e
"$@" > "$OUT/stdout.txt" 2> "$OUT/stderr.txt"
RC=$?
set -e
END=$(date +%s)
find "$TDIR" -name '*.jsonl' 2>/dev/null | sort > "$OUT/transcripts.after"
comm -13 "$OUT/transcripts.before" "$OUT/transcripts.after" > "$OUT/transcripts.new"
{
  echo "arm: $ARM"
  echo "command: $*"
  echo "exit-code: $RC"
  echo "wall-seconds: $((END-START))"
  echo "stdout bytes: $(wc -c < "$OUT/stdout.txt")"
  echo "stderr bytes: $(wc -c < "$OUT/stderr.txt")"
  echo "new transcript files: $(wc -l < "$OUT/transcripts.new")"
  while read -r t; do
    [ -n "$t" ] && echo "  transcript lines: $(wc -l < "$t")  path-basename: $(basename "$t")"
  done < "$OUT/transcripts.new"
  echo "--- stdout (first 1200 bytes) ---"; head -c 1200 "$OUT/stdout.txt"; echo
  echo "--- stderr (first 600 bytes) ---"; head -c 600 "$OUT/stderr.txt"; echo
} | tee "$OUT/summary.txt"
